mainEntity.name: How can I transcribe Hindi audio to text for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use Google Docs voice typing with हिन्दी selected, YouTube auto-captions for videos, or the free plan of an AI transcription tool. Meetings are covered by Lynkk's free plan: 5 notes a month, Hindi included. Whichever you pick, trial it on 5 minutes of your own audio first.

Yes. Google Docs voice typing supports Hindi in Chrome, YouTube generates Hindi auto-captions, and Google Cloud Speech-to-Text offers Hindi as a paid API. Docs voice typing also runs in Edge and Safari. The bottleneck is speed: it transcribes only in real time, so a 1-hour recording takes at least an hour.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Hindi transcription and translation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Transcription writes spoken Hindi as Hindi text. Translation converts it into another language, such as English, while transliteration writes Hindi words in Roman script. Many people searching for English to Hindi transcription actually need translation or transliteration, so pick the right one before choosing a tool.

Some tools can. Lynkk has a Hinglish setting for meetings where speakers switch between Hindi and English mid-sentence, whereas many other tools expect one language per recording. Before rolling anything out, test a real Hinglish meeting of 10 to 20 minutes. Watch names, numbers and English terms.

mainEntity.name: Which app is best for Hindi transcription of meetings?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI meeting assistant that supports Hindi is the most practical choice, because it also summarises and lists action items. Lynkk, for example, handles Hindi and Hinglish on Google Meet, Zoom, Teams and in person. Data processing can stay in India at the workspace level.

Yes, with clean input. AI Hindi transcription is accurate for clear audio with one speaker at a time. Still check names, numbers and English terms, and have a fluent speaker review anything legal, medical or published.
